create_fp8_quant_linear_layer: create a WeightFP8ActFP8StaticQuantLinear layer with specified input and output features for FP8 quantization
build_fp8_layer_from_original: build a WeightFP8ActFP8StaticQuantLinear layer from an original torch.nn.Linear layer using from_original class method
quantize_tensor_to_fp8: quantize a PyTorch tensor to float8_e4m3fn format using _quant_tensor_to_fp8_with_scale with a given scale
dequantize_fp8_weight_online: dequantize the FP8 weight of a WeightFP8ActFP8StaticQuantLinear layer back to its original dtype using dequant_weight_online
run_fp8_quantized_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a WeightFP8ActFP8StaticQuantLinear layer with bf16 input and get quantized output
